title: Parity of an Affine Linear Function h(t) = 2t + 1
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine whether the linear function h(t) = 2t + 1 is even, odd, or neither, and give reasons for your answer.

steps.title: Evaluate h(-t)
steps.explanation: Replace t with -t in the linear formula h(t) = 2t + 1 to obtain h(-t) = -2t + 1.
steps.why: The slope term 2t changes sign while the non-zero y-intercept +1 remains unchanged.

steps.title: Compare with h(t) and -h(t)
steps.explanation: Since -2t + 1 != 2t + 1 (for t != 0) and -2t + 1 != -2t - 1, h(-t) equals neither h(t) nor -h(t).
steps.why: A non-horizontal line (m != 0) with a non-zero y-intercept (b != 0) neither reflects across the y-axis nor passes through the origin.

steps.title: Conclude Function Parity
steps.explanation: The function h(t) = 2t + 1 is neither even nor odd.
steps.why: Combining a non-zero odd term (2t) and a non-zero even constant (1) breaks both parities.
